message.name: gorur_gari_ros2_to_mcu_msg
message.description: Gorur Gari ROS2 to MCU Serial Message

message.name: gorur_gari_ros2_to_mcu_connect_msg
message.description: Sent once by mcu_bridge when it opens the serial link, so the MCU can show on the status LED that ROS2 is talking to it

message.name: gorur_gari_ros2_to_mcu_timer_msg
message.description: Run stopwatch from the ROS2 run_timer node, so the OLED can show the run time without a laptop attached. Sent repeatedly while the link is up; elapsed_ms stops advancing once state leaves 1
message.field: 0 = idle (no run yet), 1 = running, 2 = stopped (final time)
